newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares erase early losses, end flat.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares erase early losses, end flat.

text.p: Greek equities started firm hovering around 1,400 points in early trade, then headed south and bounced back late in the session to end flat. Market watchers expected narrow trade in the next few days.
"We'll be moving sideways in the 1,360-1,420 range heading into the Easter holidays," said a fund manager.

Following a better-than-expected March CPI inflation figure -- 6.0 percent -- banks started a new round of interest rate cuts last week. The focus now is on April CPI which is expected to dip below 6.0 percent.
An informal Reuters poll of bankers and economists produced a mean forecast of 5.7 percent. Forecasts ranged from 5.5 - 6.0 percent.
Greece's current account deficit rose 59 percent year-on-year to $4.5 billion in 1996, the widening reflecting a 7.1 percent higher trade deficit of $18.3 billion.
Subscriptions to Xiosbank's IPO started on Tuesday April 15-18. The bank is going public at 2,650 drachmas a share seeking to raise 4.43 billion.
On the earnings front, Strintzis Lines said its profit rose 20 percent to 2.53 billion drachmas in 1996 and raised its dividend per share to 70 drachmas.

Closed-end fund Hellenic Invest will trade ex-rights and ex-dividend on Wednesday. It will tap the market for 6.41 billion drachmas through a rights issue at 1,900 drachmas, 17 percent below its net asset value per share.
The fund said profits have tripled in the first quarter.
The Athens general share index ended 0.01 percent or 0.09 points lower at 1,394.89 from Monday's 1,394.98 close, after opening at 1,397.52. The session's low was at 1,380.21.
Turnover fell to 10.9 billion drachmas on volume of 3.7 million shares. Decliners led advancers 107 to 103 with 28 issues unchanged on 238 traded.
Banks firmed 0.19 percent with construction shedding 0.61 percent. Industrials slipped 0.30 percent.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 1,091.0-1,121.0. Shares of OTE telecom, the underlying, lost 10 drachmas to close at 6,100.

The ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted higher at $54.80-$56.50. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.
The ING Baring Financial Products American- style call warrant on a basket of six blue-chips denominated in drachmas was quoted at 1,849-2,038 drachmas.
The strike price is set at 10,000 drachmas and the warrants expire on February 2, 1998.

The recently launched ING Baring American-style second call warrant on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted higher at $11.14-$12.84. The strike price is set at $110.0 and the warrants expire April 9 1998.
